meta.title: Duty Group
meta.description: They arrive to investigate as is their duty, but find more questions than answers instead.

units.rawText: The observational tower.
units.displayText: The observational tower.

spans.text: The observational tower.

units.rawText: I see that inspection mode's already active. Croque, what do you see inside?
units.displayText: I see that inspection mode's already active. Croque, what do you see inside?

spans.text: I see that inspection mode's already active. Croque, what do you see inside?

units.rawText: It's all more or less normal. Whoever we're looking for hasn't made too much of a nuisance yet. I'm taking a deeper look.
units.displayText: It's all more or less normal. Whoever we're looking for hasn't made too much of a nuisance yet. I'm taking a deeper look.

spans.text: It's all more or less normal. Whoever we're looking for hasn't made too much of a nuisance yet. I'm taking a deeper look.

units.rawText: Thankfully, we've got Jiangyu and Aki helping us out with the intruders, so we can focus on our target. How's Horizon?
units.displayText: Thankfully, we've got Jiangyu and Aki helping us out with the intruders, so we can focus on our target. How's Horizon?

spans.text: Thankfully, we've got Jiangyu and Aki helping us out with the intruders, so we can focus on our target. How's Horizon?

units.rawText: I've settled her in a room inside the observation tower to rest.
units.displayText: I've settled her in a room inside the observation tower to rest.

spans.text: I've settled her in a room inside the observation tower to rest.

units.rawText: The Medical Department's concluded a remote inspection. Horizon was injected with some harmless solution, and she'll recover soon. Appears to be nothing more than some sort of prank.
units.displayText: The Medical Department's concluded a remote inspection. Horizon was injected with some harmless solution, and she'll recover soon. Appears to be nothing more than some sort of prank.

spans.text: The Medical Department's concluded a remote inspection. Horizon was injected with some harmless solution, and she'll recover soon. Appears to be nothing more than some sort of prank.

units.rawText: Injected with a solution... wonder who's the culprit for that...
units.displayText: Injected with a solution... wonder who's the culprit for that...

spans.text: Injected with a solution... wonder who's the culprit for that...

units.rawText: Hey, Croque, look at the screen! The shopping street's outer circuit is returning some sort of abnormality!
units.displayText: Hey, Croque, look at the screen! The shopping street's outer circuit is returning some sort of abnormality!

spans.text: Hey, Croque, look at the screen! The shopping street's outer circuit is returning some sort of abnormality!

units.rawText: I've got it!
units.displayText: I've got it!

spans.text: I've got it!

units.rawText: Croque immediately enlarges the screen before the two of them. A red dot convulse in the air above the festival grounds.
units.displayText: Croque immediately enlarges the screen before the two of them. A red dot convulse in the air above the festival grounds.

spans.text: Croque immediately enlarges the screen before the two of them. A red dot convulse in the air above the festival grounds.

units.rawText: But the route... doesn't seem to exactly match up with what I set it to.
units.displayText: But the route... doesn't seem to exactly match up with what I set it to.

spans.text: But the route... doesn't seem to exactly match up with what I set it to.

units.rawText: Could the program have iterated by itself?
units.displayText: Could the program have iterated by itself?

spans.text: Could the program have iterated by itself?

units.rawText: By all means, it shouldn't... but regardless of what exactly happened, we've gotta get moving.
units.displayText: By all means, it shouldn't... but regardless of what exactly happened, we've gotta get moving.

spans.text: By all means, it shouldn't... but regardless of what exactly happened, we've gotta get moving.

units.rawText: Sakuya, remind Jiangyu and Aki to take care. We'll go handle this unruly mistake.
units.displayText: Sakuya, remind Jiangyu and Aki to take care. We'll go handle this unruly mistake.

spans.text: Sakuya, remind Jiangyu and Aki to take care. We'll go handle this unruly mistake.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Event grounds, outer circuit of the shopping street.
units.displayText: Event grounds, outer circuit of the shopping street.

spans.text: Event grounds, outer circuit of the shopping street.

units.rawText: We're about a minute out until the red dot comes by here again.
units.displayText: We're about a minute out until the red dot comes by here again.

spans.text: We're about a minute out until the red dot comes by here again.

units.rawText: Understood. I'm ready.
units.displayText: Understood. I'm ready.

spans.text: Understood. I'm ready.

units.rawText: Are you really going through with this? It's your creation, after all...
units.displayText: Are you really going through with this? It's your creation, after all...

spans.text: Are you really going through with this? It's your creation, after all...

units.rawText: I know what you mean, Sakuya... but the festival's a result of everyone's work. I won't allow it to destroy what everyone's been working towards.
units.displayText: I know what you mean, Sakuya... but the festival's a result of everyone's work. I won't allow it to destroy what everyone's been working towards.

spans.text: I know what you mean, Sakuya... but the festival's a result of everyone's work. I won't allow it to destroy what everyone's been working towards.

units.rawText: I'm already resolved to take care of the problems I create with my own two hands!
units.displayText: I'm already resolved to take care of the problems I create with my own two hands!

spans.text: I'm already resolved to take care of the problems I create with my own two hands!

units.rawText: Croque!
units.displayText: Croque!

spans.text: Croque!

units.rawText: Hehe, I've been waiting for an opportunity to use that line for ages.
units.displayText: Hehe, I've been waiting for an opportunity to use that line for ages.

spans.text: Hehe, I've been waiting for an opportunity to use that line for ages.

units.rawText: No no no—7 o'clock, look up!
units.displayText: No no no—7 o'clock, look up!

spans.text: No no no—7 o'clock, look up!

units.rawText: Vrrrmmmm—a black apparatus quickly approaches the pair from above.
units.displayText: Vrrrmmmm—a black apparatus quickly approaches the pair from above.

spans.text: Vrrrmmmm—a black apparatus quickly approaches the pair from above.

units.rawText: What is that? I don't remember ever designing a function like this!
units.displayText: What is that? I don't remember ever designing a function like this!

spans.text: What is that? I don't remember ever designing a function like this!

units.rawText: Nothing to be done. Sakuya, help me with lock-on! Aegis, warming up!
units.displayText: Nothing to be done. Sakuya, help me with lock-on! Aegis, warming up!

spans.text: Nothing to be done. Sakuya, help me with lock-on! Aegis, warming up!

units.rawText: It's going through the stitching! It's caught!
units.displayText: It's going through the stitching! It's caught!

spans.text: It's going through the stitching! It's caught!

units.rawText: Get out of my sky!
units.displayText: Get out of my sky!

spans.text: Get out of my sky!

units.rawText: A beam of light strikes the source of the humming sound. After a brief silence, the sound of its pieces hitting the floor rings out.
units.displayText: A beam of light strikes the source of the humming sound. After a brief silence, the sound of its pieces hitting the floor rings out.

spans.text: A beam of light strikes the source of the humming sound. After a brief silence, the sound of its pieces hitting the floor rings out.

units.rawText: That was too easy, nothing like a design of mine... wait, this is a... drone?
units.displayText: That was too easy, nothing like a design of mine... wait, this is a... drone?

spans.text: That was too easy, nothing like a design of mine... wait, this is a... drone?

units.rawText: Pomf—
units.displayText: Pomf—

spans.text: Pomf—

units.rawText: A shower of powder soon descends from the drone, pouring various colors down all over Sakuya and Croque.
units.displayText: A shower of powder soon descends from the drone, pouring various colors down all over Sakuya and Croque.

spans.text: A shower of powder soon descends from the drone, pouring various colors down all over Sakuya and Croque.

units.rawText: Cough... cough...
units.displayText: Cough... cough...

spans.text: Cough... cough...

units.rawText: What is this? Smells strange.
units.displayText: What is this? Smells strange.

spans.text: What is this? Smells strange.

units.rawText: Ah! Croque, your hair's a different color!
units.displayText: Ah! Croque, your hair's a different color!

spans.text: Ah! Croque, your hair's a different color!

units.rawText: Huh?! Sakuya, your clothes!
units.displayText: Huh?! Sakuya, your clothes!

spans.text: Huh?! Sakuya, your clothes!

units.rawText: And the flowers! The flowers are dyed, too!
units.displayText: And the flowers! The flowers are dyed, too!

spans.text: And the flowers! The flowers are dyed, too!

units.rawText: How... that wasn't a target of ours at all, this is all that intruder's doing!
units.displayText: How... that wasn't a target of ours at all, this is all that intruder's doing!

spans.text: How... that wasn't a target of ours at all, this is all that intruder's doing!

units.rawText: Grrrr, my flowers! Their depravity knows no end! I'm going to make them pay!
units.displayText: Grrrr, my flowers! Their depravity knows no end! I'm going to make them pay!

spans.text: Grrrr, my flowers! Their depravity knows no end! I'm going to make them pay!

units.rawText: Looking at the irrevocably dyed flowers in her hands, their petals now green, Sakuya remembers something.
units.displayText: Looking at the irrevocably dyed flowers in her hands, their petals now green, Sakuya remembers something.

spans.text: Looking at the irrevocably dyed flowers in her hands, their petals now green, Sakuya remembers something.

units.rawText: Hang on, this strange-smelling dye, and Horizon's body being all stiff before... Croque, doesn't that remind you of something?
units.displayText: Hang on, this strange-smelling dye, and Horizon's body being all stiff before... Croque, doesn't that remind you of something?

spans.text: Hang on, this strange-smelling dye, and Horizon's body being all stiff before... Croque, doesn't that remind you of something?

units.rawText: ...That weird stall request?
units.displayText: ...That weird stall request?

spans.text: ...That weird stall request?

units.rawText: Sakuya nods, pulling up her terminal, and opening up the list of rejected requests.
units.displayText: Sakuya nods, pulling up her terminal, and opening up the list of rejected requests.

spans.text: Sakuya nods, pulling up her terminal, and opening up the list of rejected requests.

units.rawText:
<color=orange>The Wondrous ❤ Magical Potion Gachapon:</color><|>
Customers can draw from a varied pool and treat themselves to the magic of our concoctions~<|>
Effects include but are not limited to: <color=orange>remain active for an hour in their current stance</color>, <color=green>enjoy a night of peaceful toddler-like sleep on the spot</color>, <color=yellow>temporarily enhancements to bodily performance</color>, <color=red>immediately gain a new coating of the freshest and fashionable colors...</color><|>
What concoctions will you receive, and what magic will you discover? We look forward to your visit~<|>

units.rawText: Sakuya inspects the "immediately gain a new coating of the most fresh and fashionable colors" lines and finds a line of small print:
units.displayText: Sakuya inspects the "immediately gain a new coating of the most fresh and fashionable colors" lines and finds a line of small print:

spans.text: Sakuya inspects the "immediately gain a new coating of the most fresh and fashionable colors" lines and finds a line of small print:

units.rawText: Please note: these colors cannot be removed by any means, and will naturally dissipate after a day~
units.displayText: Please note: these colors cannot be removed by any means, and will naturally dissipate after a day~

spans.text: Please note: these colors cannot be removed by any means, and will naturally dissipate after a day~

units.rawText: ...And who put in this request?
units.displayText: ...And who put in this request?

spans.text: ...And who put in this request?

units.rawText: Croque scrolls all the way downwards to the text box with a name.
units.displayText: Croque scrolls all the way downwards to the text box with a name.

spans.text: Croque scrolls all the way downwards to the text box with a name.

units.rawText: <size=40>...F-LO-RENCE!!</size>
units.displayText: ...F-LO-RENCE!!

spans.text: ...F-LO-RENCE!!

units.rawText: Misfortune is wont to strike when it is most inopportune... to think that we have such a troublesome culprit on our hands.
units.displayText: Misfortune is wont to strike when it is most inopportune... to think that we have such a troublesome culprit on our hands.

spans.text: Misfortune is wont to strike when it is most inopportune... to think that we have such a troublesome culprit on our hands.

units.rawText: I wanted to leave her for later, but I can't stand this anymore. We're going!
units.displayText: I wanted to leave her for later, but I can't stand this anymore. We're going!

spans.text: I wanted to leave her for later, but I can't stand this anymore. We're going!

units.rawText: Wait—at least change into a different neural projection first!
units.displayText: Wait—at least change into a different neural projection first!

spans.text: Wait—at least change into a different neural projection first!
